title: App code never touches ``dependency_overrides``
intent: ``create_app`` binds the authentication and session seams once, at composition. Rebinding ``app.dependency_overrides`` in app code (e.g. replacing the principal provider) silently disables authentication or swaps the database session outside every guard. Overrides are a TEST-ONLY seam; application code has no legitimate use.

runtime.rationale: The composed app's dependency_overrides mapping stays writable after composition; the existing freeze seam could hand back a refusing mapping (the same fail-closed shape as the route freeze) but does not yet. The rule stays build-time-enforced until that seam ships.
